name: Montana

flag.description: A dark blue field with the state seal in the centre, showing a plough, a pick and a shovel before mountains and the Great Falls of the Missouri, with a ribbon reading "Oro y Plata"; the word "MONTANA" is written in gold above the seal.
flag.symbolism: The plough, pick and shovel stand for the farming and mining that built the state, and the motto "Oro y Plata" (Spanish for "gold and silver") recalls its mineral wealth.

hook: Montana is the seal-on-blue flag that writes MONTANA in plain gold capitals above the seal; Kansas and Wisconsin's names sit elsewhere.
trivia: The word "MONTANA" was added above the seal in 1981, and the law specifies the lettering in Helvetica Bold.
The motto "Oro y Plata" is Spanish, a nod to the gold and silver strikes of the 1860s.
